title: The Medicaid-Pending Balance: Monthly Accrual, Collection Hold and Settlement by Outcome
content:
**Rule.** Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, for each month a case is pending, the room and board the resident would owe privately accrues to the Medicaid-pending balance: the days in the center times the private daily rate of the occupied room under the private pay schedule. A pending accrual is posted only while the case is pending, denied or under a fair hearing. The pending balance is never billed to the resident while the outcome is open: it carries no late charge, is never sent to collections and is never a ground for a nonpayment discharge. When eligibility is approved, accruals for days on or after the eligibility start date and after the end of any transfer penalty period settle as "approved — Medical Assistance covered" and are never billed to the resident; accruals for days before the eligibility start date settle as "denied — moved to private", and days inside a transfer penalty period settle as "penalty period — private", because the resident owes the private rate for them. When the denial becomes final, every open accrual settles as "denied — moved to private" and is billed under the private-pay agreement. An accrual is settled once per settlement type.

**Accrual.** The accrual for a month is the days in the center multiplied by the private daily rate of the occupied room, rounded to the cent, accrued by calendar month. The case status on the system record decides whether an accrual may be posted: pending, denied or under a fair hearing — yes; any other status — no.

**Settlement by outcome.**

| Outcome | Days the accrual covers | Settlement | Billed to the resident |
|---|---|---|---|
| Eligibility approved | on or after the eligibility start date and after the end of any transfer penalty period | approved — Medical Assistance covered | never |
| Eligibility approved | before the eligibility start date | denied — moved to private | yes, as private-pay days |
| Eligibility approved | inside a transfer penalty period | penalty period — private | yes, at the private rate |
| Denial becomes final | every open accrual | denied — moved to private | yes, under the private-pay agreement |

**Hypothetical accrual figure.** A resident in a room whose private daily rate is 318.45 dollars is in the center 17 days of a pending month; the month's accrual is 5,413.65 dollars (17 multiplied by 318.45). While the application remains pending, that amount is held: it is not billed, carries no late charge and is not collected.
